name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2608: REG-588. At 375 and 640 CSS px with data-state off, the dash row resolved to ZERO while holding 591px of content - the chronicle, the TZ tracker and the missions were laid out, rendered and UNREACHABLE. html and body are both overflow hidden and documentElement scrollHeight minus innerHeight was 0, so there was no scrollbar anywhere in the ancestry. The cause is minmax(0,1fr) on the dash row - 1fr distributes FREE space and there was none, because the auto rows come to head 150 plus rail 521 plus tick 38 plus foot 32 which with gaps fills an 800px shell exactly. The 1fr made a starved row look like a deliberate flex row. Fixed with a FLOOR - minmax(45vh,1fr) - and overflow-y auto on the stacked shell. Measured - dash 0 to 360 at 375 and 640, and 901/1120/1440 unchanged at 505/468/494, so it is media scoped. It also removed the three real text overlaps at 375, taking the overlap ratchet to 0 at every width. AND IT IS WHY THE OVERLAP GATE LIED - that starved subtree still had bounding rects, so a rect-based check counted 21 collisions among content nobody could see. Verified on pixels and confirmed by a cold cross-family read - a visible scrollbar is present on the right side of the central panel, so content is scrollable. Still owed and named - the dash overflows HORIZONTALLY at 375.
